facts.fact: FMO, the Dutch development bank, approved an equity investment of EUR 2.40 million in Hub2 (Connekt 4 SAS), a fintech providing mobile wallet and payment services in Francophone Africa, with Cote d'Ivoire as the customer's country, effective 1 August 2024, under its Ventures Program 2.
